description: Lint-opinion rules with no upstream authority source

SK006.description: Skill body exceeds token warning threshold (4400 tokens)
SK006.rationale: The 4400-token warning threshold is an empirical observation about context-window pressure, not a vendor-specified limit. No upstream spec or schema defines a maximum skill body token count.

SK007.description: Skill body exceeds token error threshold (8800 tokens) — must split
SK007.rationale: The 8800-token error threshold is an empirical observation about when skill bodies become unwieldy, not a vendor-specified limit. No upstream spec or schema defines a maximum skill body token count.

SK004.rationale: The 20-character minimum description length is a quality heuristic, not a spec requirement. The agentskills.io schema sets minLength=1 for description; the 20-char threshold is a lint opinion for description quality.

SK005.description: Skill description must contain at least one trigger phrase (e.g., 'use when', 'use this', 'trigger', 'activate')
SK005.rationale: Trigger phrases enable the model to decide when to auto-load a skill. No vendor schema or spec defines a required set of trigger phrases. The specific phrase list is a lint opinion.
SK005.constraint: Description must contain at least one of: 'use when', 'use this', 'use on', 'used when', 'used by', 'when ', 'trigger', 'activate', 'load this', 'load when', 'invoke'

AS007.description: Wildcard patterns in tools field will not resolve — list each tool by its exact registered name
AS007.rationale: No schema or vendor document defines wildcard validation for the tools field. This is a safety recommendation to prevent tools that silently fail to match.
AS007.constraint: Reject tool entries containing wildcard characters (e.g., mcp__Ref__*)

FM004.description: Multiline YAML syntax (block scalars |, >, |-, >-) in description field should be avoided
FM004.rationale: No vendor schema restricts multiline syntax in the description field. Claude Code runtime accepts it. This is a style preference for readability and portability.
FM004.constraint: Description field should use a single-line string, not a YAML block scalar or folded scalar

AS001.regex_pattern.description: Skill name must match regex ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$ — lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens
AS001.regex_pattern.rationale: The agentskills.io schema enforces maxLength=64 but does not specify a regex pattern for the name field. The lowercase-alphanumeric-with-hyphens pattern and the consecutive-hyphen prohibition have no vendor source; they are lint opinions based on convention.
AS001.regex_pattern.constraint: Name must match ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$ and must not contain consecutive hyphens (--)
